p6_b0.ocr: In the rapidly evolving landscape of e-commerce, the Gross Merchandise Volume (GMV) remains a critical metric for assessing market performance and consumer engagement. As highlighted in the table, Alibaba Group's GMV trends for the second quarter of 2025 indicate a robust growth trajectory, with a reported figure of €5.5B, representing a notable increase from €5.1B in the same quarter of the previous year.

p6_b1.ocr: This upsurge reflects a year-on-year growth rate of 38%, underscoring the resilience and adaptability of the platform in a competitive environment. Notably, the performance of specific brands within the marketplace has also contributed significantly to this growth.
